name: R5 – Cambio en parámetros de configuración de PostgreSQL

parameters.query:
WITH cambios AS (
    SELECT
        s.name AS parametro,
        b.valor_esperado,
        s.setting AS valor_actual
    FROM pg_settings s
    JOIN public.pg_settings_baseline b
        ON s.name = b.name
    WHERE s.setting IS DISTINCT FROM b.valor_esperado
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS total_cambios,
    COALESCE(
        STRING_AGG(
            parametro || ': ' ||
            COALESCE(valor_esperado, 'NULL') || ' -> ' ||
            COALESCE(valor_actual, 'NULL'),
            ' | '
        ),
        'Ninguno'
    ) AS detalle_cambios,
    COUNT(*) > 0 AS alerta_r5
FROM cambios;
